attrs.label: Inference Backend
attrs.description:
The image to use for YunKan, matching the accelerator on this system.</br>
- CPU: Any x86_64 host, no accelerator required.</br>
- OpenVINO: Intel iGPU or Arc. Enable the GPU under Resources.</br>
- CUDA: NVIDIA GPU with 6 GB VRAM or more.</br>
- TensorRT: NVIDIA GPU with 6 GB VRAM or more, builds an inference engine on first start which takes a few minutes.

enum.description: CPU
OpenVINO (Intel iGPU/Arc)
CUDA (NVIDIA)
TensorRT (NVIDIA)

attrs.label: WebRTC External IPs
attrs.description:
Addresses that clients use to reach this server, used as WebRTC ICE
candidates.</br>
Leave empty when Host Network is enabled. When it is disabled, add the
address of this system, otherwise live view falls back to HLS.

attrs.label: Mount Product UUID
attrs.description:
Mount /sys/class/dmi/id/product_uuid read-only, which makes the hardware
fingerprint used for license binding more stable.</br>
Disable it only if that file does not exist on this system, and do not
change it after activating a license - the fingerprint would change.

attrs.label: Enable mDNS
attrs.description:
Enable mDNS advertisement for YunKan.</br>
Only applies when Host Network is enabled.</br>
Note: Enabling this may interfere with other mDNS services on the host.

attrs.label: Devices
attrs.description:
Extra devices to pass through to YunKan.</br>
Eg: Host Device: /dev/accel, Container Device: /dev/accel (Intel NPU)</br>
Intel, AMD and NVIDIA GPUs are handled by the GPU Configuration section
under Resources instead.

attrs.label: Additional Environment Variables
attrs.description: See more info at https://yun-kan.com/en/docs/install#environment-variables

attrs.label: Port Bind Mode
attrs.description:
The port bind mode.</br>
- Publish: The port will be published on the host for external access.</br>
- Expose: The port will be exposed for inter-container communication.</br>
- None: The port will not be exposed or published.</br>
Note: If the Dockerfile defines an EXPOSE directive,
the port will still be exposed for inter-container communication regardless of this setting.

attrs.label: Host Network
attrs.description:
Bind to the host network.</br>
Enabled by default: WebRTC live view and camera discovery on the LAN need
direct access to the host network. Clients use 23406 (web interface) and
23515 TCP/UDP (WebRTC media); the internal media server also binds 23880
and 24214, both gated by a signed token.</br>
Disable it to run on a bridge network instead - then only the web and
WebRTC ports are published, and [WebRTC External IPs] has to be set.

1.0.9.readme:
YunKan

YunKan is a self-hosted NVR for RTSP and ONVIF IP cameras with on-device AI detection. Video stays on the local network; no vendor cloud is involved.
